method.domain: log2 of linear sRGB luminance (Rec.709 weights)
method.bands: difference of Gaussians, sigma 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256 native pixels
method.gain: least-squares slope of the variant band on the neutral band, valid pixels
method.valid: neutral luminance > 0.002, no channel >= 0.98 in either image, eroded 5x5
method.tone: median log2 change per neutral luminance bin [0.003, 0.02, 0.08, 0.25, 0.6, 1.0]
method.mid_gain_by_tone: gain of the 2-16 pixel bands per neutral luminance bin
